$\blueD{60\%}$ $\greenD{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{94}$ is the same as $\blueD{60\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{94}$.

To solve $\blueD{60\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{94}$, we need to convert $\blueD{60\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueD{60\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueD{\dfrac{60}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueD{60\div 100=0.6}$.

 $\blueD{60\%= \dfrac{60}{100} = 0.6}$

$\begin{align}\blueD{60\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{94}&=\blueD{\dfrac{60}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{94}\\\\
&=\blueD{0.6}\cdot\maroonD{94}\\\\
&=56.4
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

The fractions $\dfrac{60}{100}$ and $\dfrac{3}{5}$ are equivalent. So:

$\blueD{\dfrac{60}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{94}=\blueD{\dfrac{3}{5}}\cdot\maroonD{94}$

The expression $\blueD{\dfrac{3}{5}}\cdot\maroonD{94}$ is equivalent to $60\%$ of $94$.

$0.06\cdot 94=5.64$

The expression $0.06\cdot 94$ is **not** equivalent to $60\%$ of $94$.

$60\cdot 94=5{,}640$

The expression $60\cdot 94$ is **not** equivalent to $60\%$ of $94$.

The options that have the same value as $60\%$ of $94$ are:

- $\dfrac{60}{100}\cdot 94$
- $0.6\cdot 94$
- $\dfrac{3}{5}\cdot 94$
